name: Solana
label: SOL / NETWORK
description: Solana is a blockchain for applications and payments. SOL is its native token, used for network transaction fees and staking.
concept: A natural ocean world with detailed coastlines, soft cloud systems, mint auroral light and restrained violet orbital rings.

facts.title: The network
facts.text: Applications and wallets interact with the Solana blockchain.

facts.title: The asset
facts.text: SOL is the network’s native token. It is used to pay transaction fees.

facts.title: Explore further
facts.text: Learn how SOL transfers work, then use the official documentation to understand the network.

name: Solflare
label: SOLANA WALLET
description: Solflare is a self-custody wallet for Solana. It lets people manage assets, connect to Solana applications, and stake SOL.
concept: A rugged volcanic world with dark basalt terrain, glowing orange fissures and a thin warm atmosphere.

facts.title: What it does
facts.text: A wallet provides an interface for managing assets and interacting with blockchain applications.

facts.title: Where it fits
facts.text: Solflare focuses on the Solana ecosystem, with mobile apps and a browser extension.

facts.title: Explore further
facts.text: Visit Solflare’s official site to learn about its wallet. This planet is an educational concept, not a wallet connection.

name: Phantom
label: MULTICHAIN WALLET
description: Phantom is a self-custody wallet that supports Solana and other networks. It provides tools for managing assets and exploring blockchain applications.
concept: A textured glacial world with pale lavender ice, deep violet terrain and fine translucent dust rings.

facts.title: What it does
facts.text: Phantom brings assets and blockchain activity into a wallet interface.

facts.title: Where it fits
facts.text: Its supported networks include Solana. A wallet and a blockchain serve different roles.

facts.title: Explore further
facts.text: Use the official Phantom website to learn about the product and its supported networks.

name: Jupiter
label: SOLANA DEFI
description: Jupiter offers token swaps and other DeFi tools on Solana. Its swap routing compares available routes for exchanging one token for another. JUP is its Solana governance token.
concept: A physical gas giant with layered cream and jade cloud bands, turbulent storms and broad softly lit rings.

facts.title: What it does
facts.text: A token swap exchanges one asset for another. Jupiter provides tools for these exchanges on Solana.

facts.title: Where it fits
facts.text: Routing connects available sources of liquidity. This showcase does not execute swaps.

facts.title: Explore further
facts.text: Read Jupiter’s official product information and routing documentation. This is the project Jupiter, imagined as a world.

name: BONK
label: BONK / SOLANA COMMUNITY
description: A Solana community token with a dog-themed identity and an ecosystem spanning applications, digital art and community initiatives.
concept: A realistic orange-and-cream Shiba-inspired world with fine fur, cream brow markings, natural eyes, a detailed muzzle and upright ears.

facts.title: The community
facts.text: BONK brings a dog-themed identity to projects and communities across the Solana ecosystem.

facts.title: The token
facts.text: This showcase follows BONK’s Solana mint. Use the full address below to open the same token in PARALLAX tools.

facts.title: The world
facts.text: Ember Frontier brings BONK’s orange-and-cream Shiba identity into orbit with fine fur, natural eyes and a detailed muzzle. The realistic world is an independent PARALLAX interpretation.

name: Pudgy Penguins
label: PENGU / SOLANA COMMUNITY
description: The community token of Pudgy Penguins, a character brand spanning digital collectibles, toys and entertainment. This showcase follows its Solana token.
concept: A realistic penguin-inspired world with fine blue-gray feathers, a soft white face, dark reflective eyes, rounded flippers and a small orange beak.

facts.title: The community
facts.text: Pudgy Penguins brings its penguin characters to digital collectibles, physical products and entertainment.

facts.title: The token
facts.text: PENGU is the community’s token. This page links to the Solana mint, separately from the brand’s digital collectibles.

facts.title: The world
facts.text: Polar Haven gives the penguin-inspired world fine blue-gray feathers, a soft white face, reflective eyes and rounded flippers. It is an independent PARALLAX creation.

mintSourceLabel: Pudgy Penguins’ official account: PENGU launch

name: dogwifhat
label: WIF / SOLANA COMMUNITY
description: A Solana meme token centered on the image of a dog wearing a knitted hat.
concept: A realistic tan Shiba-inspired world with fine fur, calm eyes, a cream muzzle and a salmon-pink knitted hat with a textured rolled brim.

facts.title: The community
facts.text: dogwifhat centers on a familiar image: a dog wearing a knitted hat.

facts.title: The token
facts.text: WIF is a meme token on Solana. The official project site links to the mint used throughout this showcase.

facts.title: The world
facts.text: Rose Dunes pairs a realistic tan Shiba face with a salmon-pink knitted hat. Fine fur, calm eyes and the textured brim retain the familiar identity in this independent PARALLAX world.

name: Popcat
label: POPCAT / SOLANA COMMUNITY
description: A Solana meme token inspired by Popcat, the internet meme featuring a cat whose mouth opens into an O shape.
concept: A realistic cream-and-taupe cat world with fine fur, detailed ears and whiskers, a pink nose and the familiar wide open-mouth expression.

facts.title: The community
facts.text: Popcat takes its identity from the internet cat meme and its recognizable open-mouth expression.

facts.title: The token
facts.text: This showcase follows the Solana token address published on the Popcat project site.

facts.title: The world
facts.text: Copper Echo keeps the familiar open-mouth expression with realistic cream-and-taupe fur, detailed ears and fine whiskers. The cat world is an independent PARALLAX creation.

name: Sheeple
label: SHEEPLE / SOLANA COMMUNITY
description: A Solana community built around a camera-headed sheep and a watchful flock. Its official site identifies a primary SHEEPLE / OFFICIAL TRUMP pool while describing the projects as independent.
concept: A realistic ivory sheep world with dense curled fleece, a detailed black security-camera head, a red collar, dark split hooves and a tilted solar panel.

facts.title: The flock
facts.text: Sheeple’s camera-headed sheep gives its flock a watchful identity. Explore its own website and community account below.

facts.title: The token
facts.text: The Solana mint below comes from Sheeple’s official token page. Its stated primary pool pairs SHEEPLE with OFFICIAL TRUMP; the projects are independent.

facts.title: The world
facts.text: Flock Haven brings Sheeple’s camera-headed sheep into orbit with realistic curled fleece, a detailed black CCTV head, a red collar, dark split hooves and a tilted solar panel. This world is an independent PARALLAX creation.

name: OFFICIAL TRUMP
label: TRUMP / SOLANA COMMUNITY
description: The Solana meme token identified as OFFICIAL TRUMP on gettrumpmemes.com. This showcase follows that exact mint, also named by Sheeple as its primary pool’s paired token.
concept: A realistic portrait world with swept blond hair, natural skin detail, blue eyes, a navy suit, white collar, red tie and a slender champagne-gold orbit.

facts.title: The project
facts.text: The name OFFICIAL TRUMP identifies the token on its issuer’s website. The PARALLAX planet is independently created.

facts.title: The token
facts.text: Research links use the complete Solana mint published at gettrumpmemes.com. Sheeple identifies this token as its primary liquidity-pool pair.

facts.title: The world
facts.text: Gilded Frontier pairs a realistic portrait and swept blond hair with a navy suit, white collar, red tie and a slender gold orbit. This independent PARALLAX world neighbors Sheeple based on its published market pairing.
